extension.description: Autonomous AI task runner with Kanban board, project memory and multi-engine support.
config.engine.description: Recommended chat engine injected into the task prompt (copilot, codex, claude, opencode). This does not switch the Chat provider. In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.modelProfiles.description: Recommended engine, model and mode by inferred task type (default, bugfix, review, security). Injected as a prompt recommendation; Ralph does not force the Chat provider or model. Use Ralph vocabulary only (`copilot`/`codex`/`claude`/`opencode`, `execute`/`review`). Do not use luna/terra/sol. Empty model means the provider default. Unknown modes such as `security-audit` become `execute` (or `review` when the task type is review). In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.maxLoops.description: Maximum number of tasks to execute per auto-run session before pausing.
config.freshContext.description: Open a new chat window for each task (fresh context, no history bleeding between tasks). Recommended: true.
config.prdPath.description: Path to prd.json relative to the workspace root. Default: docs/ralph/prd.json. If that file is missing and a root prd.json exists, Ralph uses the legacy root file. Custom paths are honoured and cannot escape the workspace.
config.memoriesPath.description: Path to the project memories file relative to the workspace root.
config.guardrails.description: Rules injected into every task prompt. The agent must follow these at all times. In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.boundaries.description: Paths the agent must never touch (e.g. legacy/**, *.lock). In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.taskTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the agent to complete a task before timing out. Default: 600000 (10 minutes).
config.taskRetries.description: Number of times to retry a task after a timeout before marking it as failed. Default: 1.
config.minWaitMs.description: Minimum time in milliseconds to wait before starting to poll for task completion. Default: 15000 (15 seconds).
config.pollIntervalMs.description: How often in milliseconds to check whether the agent has completed a task. Default: 5000 (5 seconds).
config.agentRole.description: Role of the AI agent — injected into AGENTS.md (e.g. Senior Software Engineer). In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.agentStack.description: Tech stack of the project, comma-separated (e.g. PHP 8.1, WordPress, Python 3.11). Used to personalise AGENTS.md. In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.agentProject.description: Short description of the project for AGENTS.md context. In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.agentCheckpoints.description: Actions that require a confirmation checkpoint before the agent executes them (e.g. delete files, modify DB schema). In Alfred mode this setting does not apply.
config.memoryOptimizeEvery.description: Auto-optimize memories.md every N completed tasks (0 = disabled). When triggered, runs a compression pass before the next task.
config.memoryOptimizeReview.description: When true, shows the optimization prompt in Chat so you can review before it runs. When false, the agent rewrites memories.md directly without confirmation.

command.initProject.title: Ralph: Start New Project
config.alfredMode.description: Alfred Dev mode. `auto` (default): if SrScorpio.alfred-dev-vscode is installed, trusted and announces the identity command, Ralph injects Alfred's identity and silences its own guardrails, boundaries, agent*, engine and modelProfiles. `off`: Ralph always behaves as before. Read on every action, no cache.
